TCP::lossfilterrate
Description
This iRule command gets the TCP Loss Ignore Rate Parameter. Gets the
maximum number of packets per million lost before triggering congestion
response.
Rate range is valid from 0 to 1,000,000. Rate is X packets lost per
million before congestion control kicks in.
Syntax
TCP
::
lossfilterrate
Examples
when
SERVER_CONNECTED
{
# Remove loss filter if present
if
{
[
TCP
::
lossfilterrate
]
>
0
}
{
TCP
::
lossfilter
0
0
}
}
